summary.intent: Use the GSD manager dashboard to drive a full milestone-management session in cipher-box: reconcile Phase 69's stale status, discuss Phase 71, plan and execute Phase 70 (rotation soundness), ship Phase 70 through the full verify/secure/validate/CI pipeline, and then clean up completed todos and resolve PR reviews for the resulting PR.
summary.outcome: Phase 69 was confirmed already-shipped and marked complete (milestone 11/15); Phase 71 was discussed with 9 decisions locked into 71-CONTEXT.md; Phase 70 was planned, executed (8 plans/6 waves), caught and fixed a real concurrent-add revocation bug via the live sdk-e2e gate, passed security/validation, and shipped as draft PR #596 with CI 26/26 green. Follow-up cleanup moved 4 completed todos, and PR-review triage found 9 real review threads (5 contained fixes applied, a genuine depth≥2 crash-resume soundness gap confirmed and deferred to a new todo) with the resolve-pr-reviews flow still in progress at session end.

repo: gsd-tools' `init.manager` directory-status heuristic globs `*PLAN*.md` and can miscount unrelated files (e.g. a `*-RESEARCH.md` file containing the substring 'PLAN' in 'PLANE') as an extra plan, showing a phase as `partial` even when `verify phase-completeness <N>` correctly reports it done — treat the strict verifier as authoritative over the dashboard heuristic.

Backgrounding GSD plan/execute agents on Claude Code is unsafe: the background agent operates on the same shared git checkout and can switch branches out from under the foreground session, entangling unrelated uncommitted work (discuss artifacts, completion bookkeeping) into its commits. GSD's own manager.md documents this — background dispatch is only safe on Codex; Claude Code should run plan/execute inline.

Background/worktree-isolated agent sessions can block the Write tool via a `bgIsolation` guard; it can be disabled per-repo by adding `bgIsolation: "none"` to the gitignored `settings.local.json` (never edit the committed `settings.json`).

cipher-box's root-ownership model has two stores: `vaults` (owner_id FK, unique — authoritative) and `ipns_records.is_root` (user_id is explicitly documented as a non-authoritative denormalized marker; authority is proven by signature). `share-invite.service.ts` previously trusted neither and copied rootIpnsName/rootNodeId verbatim from client input.

Post-Phase-67 TEE lease-renewer structurally cannot repoint a CID on republish — it re-signs the existing value+sequence via a separate EOL-only write path with no `metadataCid` field, so same-sequence + different-CID is always an anomaly (never a legitimate republish).

Phase 70's `enqueueConcurrentlyAddedChildren` over-reached its own spec (design §4.5 says merge+re-seal a concurrently-added child, not `rotateOne` it) — rotating it needs a write key the rotator may not hold and had an orphaned-parent-pointer bug. Only caught because the live sdk-e2e gate exercised depth-2 rotation; unit/typecheck missed it entirely.

GSD executor commits use non-conventional `feat 70-02:` (space) subjects that fail the `pr-release-preview` CI gate; must reword to `feat(70-02):` before opening a PR, via `filter-branch` (no `git rebase -i` available in this environment).

CodeRabbit skips reviewing draft PRs on GitHub — must rely on the local `coderabbit review --agent` CLI pass before shipping as a draft; `greptile-apps` also posts inline PR review threads independently.

Phase 70's crash-safety e2e Test 4 used a childless rotation root (a documented sidestep of the T1 'unrecoverable window'), so no test ever actually exercised a genuine depth≥2 mid-walk crash-resume — the gate passed vacuously on that dimension.

code.finding: renewIpnsRecord re-signs value+sequence parsed from the existing record; request body has no metadataCid field, so republish cannot repoint the CID.
EOL-only republish write path never touches latestCid — never reaches the same-seq upsertIpnsRecord branch.
owner_id is a unique FK to users.id and is the authoritative one-vault-per-user binding; no root_node_id column exists, so rootNodeId can't be validated server-side without a schema change.
createInvite copied dto.rootIpnsName/rootNodeId verbatim from untrusted client input with no ownership lookup.
Code comment explicitly documents cross-store atomic transaction (todo item 1) as out of scope for Phase 70 SC#5 — confirms this residual is intentional, not an oversight.
Fix for the concurrent-add bug reused existing mergeRotatedChildren/resolveChildKeyAndEnvelope helpers with correct terminal-owner zeroization — no duplication introduced.

workflow: Before trusting a background agent's git-hygiene report, independently inspect commit-by-commit diffs (`git show --stat` per commit) — the plan-70 agent's own housekeeping swept unrelated uncommitted edits (Phase 69 bookkeeping, Phase 71 STATE) into its 'plans' commit without flagging it as entanglement.

When a live e2e gate reports a failure, classify it (test-fixture omission vs. real production gap) with a dedicated investigation before either dismissing or force-fixing — the concurrent-add failure looked like it could be a fixture issue but was a genuine spec violation.

Independently re-run a fixer/executor-reported 'all green' result rather than trusting the summary, especially for load-bearing gates (done twice: after the concurrent-add fix, and after the CodeRabbit code fixes).

For deferred/large findings from PR review, write a dedicated todo with precise technical analysis rather than a vague placeholder — enables future work to pick it up without re-deriving the investigation.
Commit-helper timeouts can be false negatives (e.g. 1Password SSH signing latency) — verify via `git log --oneline -1` before retrying, to avoid double-committing.

friction: GSD manager dashboard shows Phase 69 as 'partial' due to a plan-file glob miscounting a research doc — required manual investigation across multiple commands (manifest, verification doc, CI status) to confirm it was already shipped, and the cosmetic dashboard bug still isn't fixed at the tool level.

Backgrounding the Phase 70 planner caused a branch collision: it switched the shared working tree to its own feature branch mid-session, entangling uncommitted Phase 69-completion and Phase 71-discussion edits, requiring careful post-hoc git surgery to separate into distinct branches.
Write tool was blocked by a bg-isolation guard when writing CONTEXT.md, requiring discovery and use of a `settings.local.json` escape hatch (`bgIsolation: none`).

The plan-70 agent's own commit swept Phase 69/71 bookkeeping edits into its 'docs(70): create phase plan' commit, needing per-commit file inspection to confirm scope before deciding what to separate vs. accept as harmless interleaving.

sdk-e2e live gate required manual docker-stack bring-up (compose file discovery, secret mismatch between e2e default and API's TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, dist rebuilds) since no compose recipe existed at the expected path.
A `git commit` call timed out (likely due to 1Password SSH signing or lint-staged) — had to verify via git log that it actually landed rather than blindly retrying.
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL incompatibility, requiring a `gh api -X PATCH` workaround for PR body updates.
PR review threads GraphQL query hit transient network timeouts multiple times, requiring retries before the 9 real review threads (from two separate reviewers) were discovered.
CodeRabbit skips review on draft PRs, so its GitHub-side pass had to be preemptively covered by a local CLI run instead.
open_items: PR #596 (Phase 70) left as draft — merge decision explicitly deferred to the user.
Two items in the 'rotation-hardening-followups' todo (cross-store atomic bump-transaction, reconcile cached generation at client.ts:1341) remain unresolved and documented as accepted residuals.
A Phase-69 residual FUSE live-wiring todo remains pending, untouched by this session.

New todo `2026-07-08-rotation-crash-resume-depth2-soundness-gap.md` captures a confirmed real gap (T1/T2/T8): verifySubtreeClean's depth-N dirty items aren't matched by the resume path's rootNode.children-only search, and Test 4's childless-root design means depth≥2 crash-resume was never actually exercised — needs new e2e coverage and a real fix.
T4 (floor-write-failure propagation requiring a HighWaterStore::put signature change) deferred as a heavy-lift finding, not yet ticketed at end of transcript.
Phase 69's roadmap-checkbox bookkeeping is riding along in the Phase 70 PR rather than being split into its own PR (deemed not worth the git surgery).
Phase 71 is discussed (9 decisions in 71-CONTEXT.md on branch feat/phase-71-share-invite-security) but not yet planned or executed.

At session end, /resolve-pr-reviews was still in progress — 5 contained findings fixed and committed, depth-gap todo about to be committed, but threads not yet replied-to/resolved on GitHub and final CI status not yet reconfirmed.
